messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Auto-alert: sudden spike in 502/504 at api-gateway-us-west — 5xx rate jumped to 14% over baseline in last 4m. Affected endpoints: POST /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings. p95 latency hit 1.1s. Dash: https://metrics.redwood/boards/gateway-usw
StatusBot: Incident I-2026-78 created and paged oncall.
Sam (oncall): Ack. I'm taking the page. Who can look at edge proxy and nw-proxy stacks?
Jo (edge): I'm on edge. Quick glace: edge-proxy logs show a lot of `502 Bad Gateway` with `upstream write failed` and `unexpected EOF`. No deploys in the last hour to edge-proxy.
Diego (runtime): Checking model-inference fleet. Some worker pods showing OOMKilled traces around the same time, but they restarted. Replica count stable. Looks like elevated request queuing > 500ms on a subset of pods.
Lina (infra): LB health shows backend target group 2/10 unhealthy for model-inference-usw. Kernel socket stats show high TIME_WAIT and a rise in `somaxconn` drops. We pushed a networking config 20m ago (tcp_tw_reuse toggled). Could be related.
Maya (sre): Tracing sample: trace 9f8e7d — request path: client -> edge -> nw-proxy -> inference -> upstream reset. Upstream returns 504 after 15s occasionally, but most are 502 on stream failure. See trace: https://tracing.redwood/9f8e7d
Sam (oncall): Hypotheses: (A) recent net config caused ephemeral port exhaustion / conn reuse regression; (B) sudden retry amplification from clients causing queueing; (C) a subset of inference pods flapping. Immediate mitigations: 1) disable recent tcp_tw_reuse toggle (Lina) 2) temporarily increase inference replicas + reduce per-pod concurrency (Diego) 3) apply fast-fail circuit breaker at gateway for inference (Jo). Execute in parallel. Also put a brief note on status page.
Lina (infra): Reverting tcp_tw_reuse now across us-west hosts. Command: `ansible-playbook -e toggle_tcp_tw=false playbooks/net-tuning.yml`
Diego (runtime): Scaling inference: `kubectl patch hpa inference-usw -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 6}}' -n inference'` and setting per-pod max concurrency env var to 50. Rolling update in progress.
Jo (edge): Enabling circuit-breaker rule on gateway for model-inference with fail_threshold=5, cooldown=20s. Pushing rule now.
Maya (sre): Injected synthetic traffic to validate behavior. Observed 5xx drop from 14% -> 7% after scale+revert. p95 down from 1100ms -> 480ms. Still noisy though.
Sam (oncall): Good. Who owns customer comms? I'll draft a short update: "We are actively mitigating elevated 5xx in US-WEST; initial mitigations reduced error rate. More updates in 15 minutes." Lina/Diego/Maya: please capture any config changes for postmortem.
Diego (runtime): Observed in pod logs: `write: connection reset by peer` immediately before OOM messages on a few older instances (node age 45d). Draining and replacing those nodes now. Also found a memory leak in the transcode worker that could cause elevated GC pausing under spike; creating hotfix branch.
Maya (sre): Traces show client SDK retries are too aggressive (no jitter, retry-after 0). I pushed a temporary edge rate-limit that caps rapid retries per ip: 10 requests / 10s.
Lina (infra): Sysctl revert completed on all canaries and then rolled to 50% of hosts. Net stats: TIME_WAIT count dropping. Also increased `net.core.somaxconn` from 1024 -> 4096 on proxy pool as a stopgap.
StatusBot: Status page updated: "Investigating elevated 5xx in US-WEST; partial mitigations applied; more details to follow."
Sam (oncall): Monitoring window 10m. If error rate <4% and p95 <350ms we'll move to recovery. Current metrics: 5xx=3.9%, p95=330ms. Looks like trending down.
Diego (runtime): Hotfix branch merged to limit per-request buffer sizes that were contributing to large transfer windows. Rolling to 20% of inference fleet.
Maya (sre): Noted customer reports: 18 tickets flagged in the past 30m, most transient. Opened incident channel for top 5 impacted customers and pinged CS.
Jo (edge): One more change: forcing `Connection: close` on large payloads (>12KB) to avoid long-lived streams tying up backend slots. Rule applied.
Sam (oncall): Good catch. Assigning postmortem owners: Lina (infra), Diego (runtime), Maya (sre). Please include timeline, config diff, nodes replaced, and guidance for SDK retry/backoff.
Lina (infra): Will schedule a follow-up to revert temporary increases (somaxconn) after stabilization and document the sysctl change audit.
Maya (sre): Captured full trace/log bundle: https://diag.redwood/export/I-2026-78. Will set up RCA doc and invite owners.
Sam (oncall): Customer update to execs: "US-WEST experienced a spike of 502/504 between 21:12-21:38 UTC; mitigations (net-config revert, scale + hotfix, retry-rate limiting) reduced errors to baseline. No evidence of data corruption. Postmortem scheduled."
Diego (runtime): Current health: 5xx=1.8%, p95=210ms, unhealthy backend targets -> 0/10. Replacements completed.
Maya (sre): Leaving monitoring for 90 minutes before incident is closed. Will capture any regression alerts.
Sam (oncall): Closing the page and marking incident as mitigated. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
